purpose: Correct procedural-source dating and prevent historical-rule pages from being treated as standalone current-law authority.

corrections.finding: Tailte Éireann's current page reproduces Rule 160 from the 2012 Rules, while the 2021 Rules state that the 2021 Rules operate together with the earlier Rules.
corrections.required_display: Show the rule-history/current-framework context rather than presenting the 2012 page as a standalone current instrument.

corrections.finding: Tailte Éireann currently publishes Forms 89 and 90 and identifies them as Rule 160 official-search forms.
Tailte Éireann's current forms catalogue lists LR Forms 88-92 and Form 96, among many other Land Registry forms.
The Courts Service current Order 96 page identifies the Registration of Title Act 1964 procedure and records later amendments to the Order, including S.I. 261/2023.

legal_safety_rule: A current official webpage may reproduce a historical statutory rule. The system must retain the rule's legislative date, later instruments and current procedural status before presenting it as current law.
guardrails: Historical rule text is not silently relabelled as current standalone legislation.
Current form availability is separated from substantive legal effect.
